settings/tournament.name: The Inter-Club Ping Pong Championship (6 Clubs)
settings/tournament.conditions:
### Inter-Club Ping Pong Championship
Welcome to the official Inter-Club Table Tennis (Ping Pong) Championship! 6 clubs (T1–T6) compete on the Single Official Competition Table across 5 fast-paced rounds (3 matches played sequentially per round — 15 total tournament matches), facing every other club once to determine the champion.

#### Tournament Format & Scoring (Single Table)
- **Single Table Setup:** All 15 tournament matches take place on the single official table in sequence.
- **Structure:** 5-Round League (3 matches played in order per round).
- **Match Format:** Single set to 11 points per match (first to reach 11 points wins).
- **Deuce Rule:** At 10–10, play continues until one player achieves a 2-point lead (e.g. 12–10, 13–11).
- **Rest Breaks:** 2–3 minutes between consecutive matches to allow players to warm up.
- **Points System:**
  - 🏓 **Win:** 1 Point
  - ❌ **Loss:** 0 Points
  - 🚫 **No Draws:** Every table tennis match ends in a decisive victory.
- **Tie-Breakers:** If clubs finish tied on points after Round 5, rankings are decided by **Head-to-Head result**, followed by **Total Wins**, then point differential.

#### The 5 Rotating Rounds (Sequential on Table 1)
- **Round 1 (Opening Clash):** Match 1: T1 vs T6 | Match 2: T2 vs T5 | Match 3: T3 vs T4
- **Round 2 (Rotation Stage):** Match 1: T5 vs T3 | Match 2: T1 vs T2 | Match 3: T6 vs T4
- **Round 3 (Mid-Tournament Battle):** Match 1: T4 vs T2 | Match 2: T5 vs T6 | Match 3: T3 vs T1
- **Round 4 (Championship Push):** Match 1: T2 vs T6 | Match 2: T1 vs T4 | Match 3: T3 vs T5
- **Round 5 (The Grand Finale):** Match 1: T1 vs T5 | Match 2: T6 vs T3 | Match 3: T4 vs T2

#### Official Table Tennis Rules & Conduct
- **Service Alternation:** Alternates every 2 points (every 1 point after 10–10 Deuce).
- **Legal Service Toss:** Ball rests on open flat palm, tossed vertically at least 16 cm without spin, struck as it falls.
- **Let Serve:** Serve touching the net and landing legally is replayed with no penalty.
- **No Volleys:** Striking the ball on the fly before it bounces forfeits the point.
- **Table Contact:** Free hand (non-racket hand) must not touch the table surface during rallies.
- **Edge Balls:** Top surface edge is in play; sides/underside are out.
- **Referee Authority:** The Table Referee supervises all matches on the single official table.
